description: This file defines functions and classes for calculating and managing the bounds and bounding boxes of graphical elements in a drawing application, including support for various shape types, transformations, and collision detection.

classes.name: ElementBounds
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate and cache bounds of graphical elements, supporting rotation and non-rotated bounds.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Retrieves the bounds of an element, using cache if valid, and calculates if necessary.

methods.name: calculateBounds
methods.description: Calculates the bounds of an element based on its shape and properties.

methods.name: getElementAbsoluteCoords
methods.description: Returns the absolute coordinates of an element, considering transformations.

methods.name: getElementLineSegments
methods.description: Returns line segments that make up the element for collision detection.

methods.name: getLinearElementRotatedBounds
methods.description: Calculates bounds for linear elements with rotation.

methods.name: getElementBounds
methods.description: Gets the bounds of an element, with optional non-rotated calculation.

methods.name: getCommonBounds
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box that encompasses multiple elements.

methods.name: getDraggedElementsBounds
methods.description: Calculates bounds of elements after applying drag offset.

methods.name: getResizedElementAbsoluteCoords
methods.description: Calculates new bounds for an element after resizing.

methods.name: getElementPointsCoords
methods.description: Gets bounds based on specific points of an element.

methods.name: getClosestElementBounds
methods.description: Finds the bounds of the element closest to a given point.

methods.name: getCommonBoundingBox
methods.description: Returns a bounding box object for a set of elements.

methods.name: getVisibleSceneBounds
methods.description: Returns the scene bounds of the visible viewport.

methods.name: getCenterForBounds
methods.description: Calculates the center point of given bounds.

methods.name: aabbForElement
methods.description: Calculates the axis-aligned bounding box for an element, considering rotation.

methods.name: pointInsideBounds
methods.description: Checks if a point is inside given bounds.

methods.name: elementCenterPoint
methods.description: Calculates the center point of an element.
